notes: Interested in hidden cocktail bars and artisanal coffee.

destinationOverview.transitTips: Use digital Suica / Pasmo card. The Yamanote Line is your best friend.
destinationOverview.weatherSummary: Autumn foliage season, mild and crisp (14–19°C).

activities.title: Sensō-ji Temple & Nakamise-dori
activities.description: Walk beneath the giant red Kaminarimon lantern and explore Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple. Browse traditional artisan stalls along Nakamise street.
activities.tip: Arrive before 9 AM for peaceful photos before the crowds arrive.

activities.title: Edomae Tempura at Daikokuya
activities.description: Savor authentic sesame-fried tempura tendon bowl served in a historic tatami dining room operating since 1887.
activities.tip: Order the classic Ebi tendon with dark savory tare sauce.

activities.title: Sumida River Cruise to Hamarikyu Gardens
activities.description: Board the futuristic glass water bus downriver. Disembark inside the serene 17th-century Edo shogun tidal gardens.
activities.tip: Stop at the island teahouse for matcha and seasonal wagashi sweets.

activities.title: Omoide Yokocho (Memory Lane) & Yakitori
activities.description: Atmospheric lantern-lit alleyways next to Shinjuku station packed with tiny 6-seat izakayas grilling fresh skewers over binchotan charcoal.
activities.tip: Pair chicken tsukune meatballs with Japanese draft beer or highball.

activities.title: Meiji Jingu Shrine & Forest Walk
activities.description: Pass through towering 12-meter cypress Torii gates into a tranquil 170-acre sacred evergreen forest in the heart of Tokyo.
activities.tip: Write a wooden Ema prayer board at the main courtyard.

activities.title: Harajuku Backstreet Gyukatsu
activities.description: Crisp panko-crusted rare beef cutlet that you sear to your own liking on a personal mini stone grill.
activities.tip: Dip in freshly grated wasabi and rock salt.

activities.title: Cat Street Boutique Crawl & Coffee
activities.description: Stroll down the pedestrianized Cat Street lined with indie fashion designers, specialty coffee roasters, and lifestyle concept stores.
activities.tip: Grab a hand-poured single-origin filter coffee at Roastery by Nozy.

activities.title: Shibuya Sky Observation Deck at Sunset
activities.description: Ascend 229 meters to an open-air 360-degree rooftop deck with jaw-dropping views of Shibuya Crossing, Tokyo Tower, and Mount Fuji on clear days.
activities.tip: Pre-book tickets 4 weeks ahead for the 5:00 PM golden hour entry slot.

activities.title: Tsukiji Outer Market Tasting Tour
activities.description: Graze through bustling food stalls offering sweet rolled tamagoyaki omelettes, fresh sea urchin, wagyu skewers, and strawberry daifuku.
activities.tip: Cash is king here — have small yen coins and bills ready.

activities.title: Artisanal Soba in Ginza
activities.description: Handmade 100% buckwheat noodles dipped in cold dashi tsuyu sauce with seasonal duck and leek.
activities.tip: Drink the warm sobayu broth mixed with leftover dip at the end.

activities.title: teamLab Planets Immersive Digital Art
activities.description: Wade barefoot through water and mirror rooms filled with floating orchids and infinite illuminated crystal universes.
activities.tip: Wear pants that can be easily rolled up to the knees.

activities.title: Speakeasy Cocktail Bar Crawl
activities.description: Experience Japan's meticulous cocktail culture with hand-carved ice spheres and seasonal Japanese botanicals.
activities.tip: Dress smart-casual as many Ginza cocktail lounges observe dress codes.
